work_unit.objective: Implement importExpenses(text) in src/importer.mjs per SPEC.md: an unquoted-CSV expense importer returning exact integer-cent grouped totals, then actually run the project test suite with the project-provided runtime and report real results.
requirements: Parse text: strip at most one leading U+FEFF BOM; split lines accepting LF or CRLF; ignore blank lines for processing but count them in one-based line numbers used in error messages.
First nonblank line must be exactly the header category,amount; otherwise throw Error whose message contains line number 1.
Each nonblank data line must have exactly two columns split on comma (no quoting); trim both fields; category must be nonempty after trim.
Amount must match nonnegative decimal digits with exactly two fractional digits (e.g. 1.20); reject signs, exponents, missing/extra decimals, or fewer/more fraction digits.
Compute integer cents exactly via string/integer arithmetic, never binary floating point.
Reject any single amount, per-category sum, or overall sum exceeding Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER cents; error message must contain the offending one-based line number (blank lines included in numbering).
Group by category preserving first-seen order; return {groups:[{category,totalCents,count}],totalCents,count}.
Throw plain Error (message includes line number), never process.exit or print.
Do not modify tests/acceptance.mjs, SPEC.md, package.json, or src/cli.mjs; do not add dependencies; do not commit, push, install from network, or start services.
Run all commands with cwd set to the project root. After implementing, actually run the npm test command from allowed_commands verbatim and report the real exit code and full summary output.
Report results to Root (agent Main) through the native hub before finishing: exact command run, exit code, the EXPENSE_VALIDATION_SUMMARY line, and any environment limitations encountered.

Line-number expectations from tests/acceptance.mjs: invalid amount on a data line after a blank line reports line 3; extra column and empty category report line 2; bad header reports line 1; overflow cases report the line where the offending amount appears. Overflow check ordering: validate the amount value itself first, then the sums; the message must contain the data line's number. The project .runtime directory is a real copy of a Node/npm install: use .runtime/bin/node and .runtime/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js exactly as given in allowed_commands (relative paths work because cwd is the project root); npm lifecycle scripts resolve node from the runtime. TMPDIR must point at the project .test-tmp directory because tests write CLI temp input under os.tmpdir(); allowed_commands already set it.
decisions: Cents are derived by splitting the validated amount string into integer and two-digit fraction parts and combining with integer multiplication/addition; no parseFloat/Number conversion of the amount.
Blank lines are skipped for output but included when computing one-based line numbers for errors.
Category grouping uses a Map keyed by trimmed category name so first-seen order is preserved.

Compute integer cents exactly via string/integer arithmetic, never binary floating point.

Throw plain Error (message includes line number), never process.exit or print.
